products.name: Blender AI Add-ons
products.note: 3D creation AI plugins; open-source; local processing; model provenance varies by plugin

profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and distributes Blender, a free 3D creation software suite. The software covers modeling, rigging, animation, rendering, camera and object tracking, Grease Pencil drawing directly in a 3D viewport, and a Python-controlled interface that supports community-built add-ons. The foundation describes Blender as used in short films, advertisements, TV series, and feature films, and notes that VFX professionals have called its tracker "probably the best tracker in the market." Blender is a member of ASWF, Khronos, Linux Foundation, and OIN, and the site lists AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm among its major hardware supporters.

On the AI side, the site tracks a product category called Blender AI Add-ons, described as third-party plugins for 3D creation that run with local processing and carry open-source licensing, though model provenance is noted to vary by plugin. Blender 5.2 LTS, referenced on the site alongside updates including a Cycles Texture Cache for more memory-efficient rendering and new Grease Pencil texture brushes, represents the current release at time of profiling. Blender Studio has also announced a feature film project called OVERGROWN. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the foundation.
